listing.name: Independent Interstellar
listing.summary: Adds more-militarized weapons of pirate mk2 ships, and a couple "what-if?" weapons. Not balanced and i didn't even attempt.
listing.aiSummary: Adds militarized variants of pirate Mk2 ships as Independent vessels, along with new weapon and hullmod options.

description: Introduces upgraded versions of the Atlas, Colossus, and Mudskipper with increased armor and OP but reduced storage and acceleration. Adds specialized weapon variants for cannons and HAGs, including options for regenerating charges or guaranteed armor damage. Includes new hullmods such as an ablative armor system, a high-speed phase coil, and a shield generator that trades speed for armor.
